title: Choose the visual world — Affey for Governor
question: The roll assigned Signboards of Wajir. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll. All directions use only the locked palette.

options.label: Signboards of Wajir
options.lineage: Hand-lettered shop and office signboards of Wajir town, where English, Kiswahili and Somali share one board
options.thesis: Every section is a flat painted board, with the promise lettered in all three languages as equals.
options.viewport: A deep-green board carries the name in huge condensed capitals, the promise in EN/SW/SO on three ruled lines, then Donate; an ochre board counts the days.
options.risk: Condensed capitals can feel loud or rustic if set carelessly; long Somali words need display sizes checked.

raised.raise: Rank by inversion: only the lead item in a section prints light on dark, so no badges or extra sizes are needed.
The countdown is a fixed-slot board rendered on the server: digits in reserved tabular cells, nothing reflows, no '––' flash.
Every milestone and priority carries identical furniture (number, title, one line), so lists read as a set, not a card grid.
One body size at a 60–66 character measure; hierarchy comes from display type, not a ladder of in-between sizes.
Motion signals a state change (enter, open, select) and then stops; nothing ambient.
Text that has been read never moves again; only entrances animate.

options.label: The Peace-Table Papers
options.lineage: Signed communiqués and state papers from the Horn of Africa peace processes
options.thesis: Each page is a signed state paper: wide margins, numbered articles, dates in the margin, a seal block.
options.viewport: Margin column with the day count and seal; the name in a large serif; the promise set as the preamble between rules; Donate below; portrait plate on the right.
options.risk: Closest to what most editorial redesigns ship (paper ground plus serif); can read cold or bureaucratic to young voters.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Content rides a roll of cloth courses stepping under one fixed window.
options.viewport: One fixed window showing the current course.
options.risk: A transit monitoring grammar; voters gain nothing from it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither voters nor the candidate identify with a depot blind.
options.kept: Rank by inversion: the lead item alone prints light on dark.

options.label: Seven-Segment Display
options.thesis: Every glyph from one eight-cell mask; unlit cells drawn too.
options.viewport: A countdown as a lit scoreboard.
options.risk: Reads as a gadget, not a statesman.
options.case: Fuses only for the countdown; loses on identification and clarity for the whole site.
options.kept: Fixed slots: place never moves, only values change.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: A ranked roster of characters with fixed name plates.
options.viewport: A pastel grid of rounded cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: wrong register for gravitas and the locked palette.
options.kept: Identical fixed furniture on every item.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Content on acetate leaves over coloured divider boards, with a tab rail.
options.viewport: An open manual at a tabbed section.
options.risk: A software-manual world voters do not share.
options.case: Fuses poorly: clear structure but no identification with Wajir or diplomacy.
options.kept: One body size at a disciplined reading measure.

options.label: Chromatophore Skin
options.thesis: A living surface whose pattern is the message.
options.risk: Heavy GPU work on mid-range Android phones; no link to the subject.
options.case: Fuses poorly and breaks the performance budget.
options.kept: Motion only as a signal of change.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.thesis: Rain falls toward whatever its cloud colour commands.
options.kept: Only the reading line holds still.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A full-bleed candidate portrait with a bold sans headline, pill buttons and card sections, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Portrait fills the screen behind a dark gradient; name, promise and two buttons bottom-left.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other campaign site by design.
